item.title: Foundations for innovative and resilient capital markets

rating.summary: Deputy Governor Vasileios Madouros of the Central Bank of Ireland delivered a keynote address at the 2026 ECMI Annual Conference focused on the future of European capital markets. The speech centers on two structural shifts: the emergence of tokenised finance and the expansion of non-bank finance. Using a LEGO analogy, he frames the discussion around building foundations that support integration, resilience, innovation, and trust in capital markets.
rating.stance_rationale: This speech is not about monetary policy; it addresses capital markets structure, financial innovation, and non-bank finance regulation. No monetary policy stance, rate signals, or inflation/growth assessments are present.
key_quotes: The first is the emergence of tokenised finance. The second is the continued expansion of non-bank finance.
The common thread running through these is building foundations that support integration, resilience, innovation and trust in our capital markets.
